beats.say: This is a Sepolia demo app, and the whole clip you are watching was recorded and edited by an agent.
Connecting a wallet opens WalletChan, which is a real browser extension running in a real browser.
The account is live. Nothing about this is mocked, and the keys never leave the extension.
Now the part that matters. Signing an attestation asks the wallet to approve, exactly as a real transaction would.
The signature comes back into the page, and the whole flow was captured without touching a mouse.
